description: Public, aggregated numbers of Space-Core before you have an account: pilots active in the last 5 minutes (including the game's own AI pilots), trades and fights won in a fixed 60-minute window that ended at least 5 minutes ago, number of sectors and the Raw Titanium list price. No player names; values below 3 are only shown as "fewer than 3". Needs no token and is not tied to any account; changes nothing in the game (only an anonymous rate counter). Numbers are refreshed at most once per minute, older numbers are marked as such. Followed by how to get an account. Optional language: de or en.

language.description: de or en (default: language from ?lang, otherwise de)

name: world_peek
title: Peek at public game numbers
